annotations.title: EVE Frontier Lagrange Network Node Gigajoule & Fuel Burn Optimizer

description: Calculates Lagrange Network Node hourly gigajoule (GJ) fuel burn rates, capacity headroom, and offline vulnerability windows for connected Smart Assemblies. Use when balancing steady-state power allocations on a single Lagrange Network Node; for stress-testing node capacitor depletion under active hostile fleet bombardment, use simulate_eve_capacitor_siege instead. Stateless read-only edge call (max 32 KB, 60 RPM): accepts 'node_id' ('operating_profile' defaults to 'balanced'), supports '?demo=true' or L402 (25 sats), and returns HTTP 400 if invalid.

operating_profile.description: Power allocation profile across connected assemblies; defaults to 'balanced' when omitted.

name: optimize_eve_node_power

burn_rate_gj_per_hr.description: Hourly gigajoule (GJ) energy consumption across attached assemblies.

hours_until_fuel_depletion.description: Remaining operational hours before fuel reserves reach zero.
